body.name: cross-fitted Yang prefix estimators and criteria
body.construction: Choose, for every fold \(f\) and prefix \(k\), learners trained outside \(f\) that satisfy \(\mathrm{ass:nuisance\text{-}estimability}\). Evaluate the displayed \(\widehat\eta_{n,k}^{(-f(i))}(O_i)\), then set \(\widehat\tau_{n,k}=(n_{\mathcal R}+k)^{-1}\sum_i\widehat W_{n,k,i}\widehat\eta_{n,k}^{(-f(i))}(O_i)\), \(\widehat\psi_{n,k,i}=n(n_{\mathcal R}+k)^{-1}\widehat W_{n,k,i}\{\widehat\eta_{n,k}^{(-f(i))}(O_i)-\widehat\tau_{n,k}\}\), after centering \(\widehat\psi_{n,k,i}\) within each fixed source stratum, set \(\widehat v_{n,k}\) and \(\widehat\Gamma_n(k,l)\) equal to the displayed pooled within-stratum covariance formulas, \(\widehat C_{n,k}=n(\widehat\tau_{n,k}-\widehat\tau_{n,0})^2+\widehat v_{n,k}\), and \(\widehat k_n=\min\arg\min_k\widehat C_{n,k}\).
